name: c-file-type-1
title: Common formats
label: Common Formats
description: The formats people share most, in their brand colors.

guidance.bestFor: A 5 column grid of 10 everyday formats in the default outline at 40px, uncaptioned because each icon names itself

whenNotToUse.when: Every built-in extension at once, grouped by family with a variant switch

name: c-file-type-2
title: Outline, solid, light and mono
label: Variants
description: The 4 variants side by side: outlined, filled, soft grey and one gray for every type.

guidance.bestFor: One row per variant over the same 5 types, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, JPG and ZIP, so only the paint changes between rows

name: c-file-type-3
title: Sizes
label: Sizes
description: 6 sizes from 18px to 56px drawing the same icon, tuned to stay legible at 18px.

guidance.bestFor: A PDF at each size preset from mini to xl, captioned with the prop value and its pixel box, bottoms aligned

name: c-file-type-4
title: Family glyphs
label: Family Glyphs
description: One glyph per family, drawn on one grid, for family types and the glyph option.

guidance.bestFor: All 13 family types from the exported category list, captioned by name, with the blank empty page placed last

name: c-file-type-5
title: All formats
label: All Formats
description: Every built-in format grouped by family, with a variant switch.

guidance.bestFor: The full extension table split into 11 family rows with counts, painted in whichever of 4 variant tabs is active
agentNotes: `GROUPS` and the count line both read `FILE_TYPE_EXTENSION_NAMES`; filter it once to list only the formats your app accepts

whenNotToUse.when: A short set of the most shared formats with no tabs or counts

name: c-file-type-6
title: Data grid file browser
label: File Browser
description: Mini icons resolved from each file name in the rows of a sortable data grid.

guidance.bestFor: Folders sorted ahead of files, a Type column filled from each family, and item counts in place of sizes for folders
agentNotes: `files` is sample data with `size` in bytes and `modified` as an ISO date; map your storage records onto `FileItem`
`manualPagination` keeps all rows on one page; drop it and the bundled pagination model shows 10 rows with no pager rendered

whenNotToUse.when: Record tables that sort and page where no row stands for a document

name: c-file-type-7
title: Attachment list
label: Attachment List
description: Attachments with their type, size and a download action.

guidance.bestFor: Static rows pairing a light page with the name, size and a dated time element, ending in a ghost download button
agentNotes: The download `Button` has no handler; point each row at its file URL or your download call
`ATTACHMENTS` holds preformatted `size` and `modifiedLabel` strings; format them from your file records

whenNotToUse.when: Documents shown as chips in a chat composer or an assistant reply
Rows that track each transfer with a bar, cancel and retry

name: c-file-type-8
title: Upload queue
label: Upload Queue
description: Files uploading with progress, each icon resolved from its MIME type.

guidance.bestFor: A live count of uploaded and failed items above rows that swap a named bar for a size line, with retry and cancel
agentNotes: `retry` marks the file done at once and `remove` only filters local state; start or abort the real transfer in both
`QUEUE` is sample data; drive each row's `progress` and `status` from your upload events

whenNotToUse.when: A queue that also needs idle and processing states for each item
A drop zone that adds new documents to the queue

name: c-file-type-9
title: Resolve from a file name
label: Resolve From Name
description: Type a file name, path, URL or MIME type and see the icon it resolves to.

guidance.bestFor: Sample chips under one input with a clear button, the result in all 4 variants and a live Type and Family readout

name: c-file-type-10
title: Custom labels
label: Custom Labels
description: Version tags and document codes in place of the extension.

guidance.bestFor: A revision history newest first, rows tagged SIGNED or V1 to V3, under a large blank page carrying a CA-1042 code
agentNotes: Replace `REVISIONS` with your versions; a `label` past 4 characters, like SIGNED, is set smaller to fit the band

whenNotToUse.when: A lock, link or star mark on the page in place of a text tag

name: c-file-type-11
title: Custom colors and unknown types
label: Custom Colors
description: Unknown extensions fall back to a neutral icon, and one class recolors any type.

guidance.bestFor: The same 4 CAD and 3D formats twice, on the default neutral page and then recolored teal, indigo, orange and rose
agentNotes: The `FORMATS` shades keep white label text at 4.5:1, 700 for teal and orange; a lighter class needs dark label text

name: c-file-type-12
title: Export format picker
label: Format Picker
description: Radio cards for choosing an export format, each with its file type icon.

guidance.bestFor: A preselected PDF choice among 5, a button labeled with the picked extension, and a status line naming the result
agentNotes: The Export `Button` only stores the pick in `exported` for the status line; run your export there

name: c-file-type-13
title: Locked, linked and starred
label: Locked & Starred
description: A lock, link or star drawn on the icon in place of the extension label.

guidance.bestFor: Pairs of outline and solid pages for 6 states, from verified and hidden to uploading, captioned with state and format
agentNotes: An `icon` is decorative, so a lone locked PDF still reads PDF file; drop `aria-hidden` and pass an `aria-label` such as Locked PDF file

whenNotToUse.when: A version number or document code in the band in place of the extension

name: c-file-type-14
title: Restyled labels
label: Restyled Labels
description: File type extension labels restyled through labelClassName: rounded, outlined, inverted, recolored.

guidance.bestFor: Each badge recipe printed beside its class string, from a pill and an inverted band to a DRAFT tag in amber

name: c-file-type-15
title: Dotfiles and build names
label: Dotfiles & Build Names
description: Icons read from names such as .env.local, Dockerfile and Makefile, which carry no usual extension.

guidance.bestFor: A 2 column list of 12 repository entries, dotfiles and extensionless build scripts among them, each icon read from the name
agentNotes: `FILES` holds bare names; pass full paths to `getFileType` as they are, since it reads only the last segment
